brief.title: Twitter to Telegram Notifications Release Hardening
brief.summary: Hardens daemon lifecycle, SQLite state, dry-run behavior, web status, Windows operations, README, and screenshot for the local X/Twitter to Telegram notifier.

reviewItems.title: X fetch cursor and Telegram retry behavior
reviewItems.why: Telegram outages should not cause repeated X reads for the same fetched tweet.
reviewItems.decisionNeeded: Confirm the pending-delivery queue is the intended cost-control tradeoff.
reviewItems.agentNext: Review CU-001 and P-001/P-004 if retry behavior changes.

reviewItems.title: Daemon lifecycle and single-instance safety
reviewItems.why: The daemon now reloads config each poll and uses a SQLite runtime lock to avoid overlapping pollers.
reviewItems.decisionNeeded: No human decision needed unless multiple daemons are intentionally desired.
reviewItems.agentNext: If multi-daemon operation is required, replace the poll lock with account-level leases.

reviewItems.title: Dry-run and empty-startup safety
reviewItems.why: Empty first startup and dry-run safety are critical for setup without accidentally mutating production state.
reviewItems.agentNext: Keep dry-run defaults no-impact unless a future workflow explicitly needs write-state previews.

reviewItems.title: Windows scheduled-task operations
reviewItems.why: Windows scripts add logs and ACLs, but PowerShell was unavailable on this Mac for local script execution.
reviewItems.decisionNeeded: Validate on the actual Windows mini PC only if that is the deployment target.
reviewItems.agentNext: Run deploy/windows-task.ps1 from elevated PowerShell and verify logs under C:\ProgramData\twitter-tg-notifs\logs.

reviewItems.title: Local web console status accuracy
reviewItems.why: The web UI now uses stored poll status, heartbeat, classifier readiness, and secrets checks instead of placeholder labels.
reviewItems.agentNext: If the status panel changes again, update the README screenshot in docs/assets/local-web-console.jpg.

changeUnits.title: Daemon and SQLite lifecycle hardening
changeUnits.reason: Add config reload, pending deliveries, daemon heartbeat, poll status, runtime lock, classifier-only secrets, and relative state-path resolution.

changeUnits.title: CLI dry-run and zero-account setup
changeUnits.reason: Make dry-run no-impact by default and allow zero-account run startup without API secrets.

changeUnits.title: Web console operational status
changeUnits.reason: Replace placeholder readiness labels with stored poll status, heartbeat, classifier status, secrets status, and invalid-config recovery.

changeUnits.title: Windows operations and docs
changeUnits.reason: Add durable Windows logs, ProgramData ACL setup, and README mini-PC instructions.

notes.title: Hermes/xAI boundary
notes.body: The local Hermes path uses the configured http_json endpoint directly. xAI is only used when provider or fallback_provider is configured for xai.

notes.title: Remaining duplicate-delivery edge case
notes.body: The pending queue avoids repeated X reads after Telegram failures. It does not fully eliminate duplicate Telegram sends if the process crashes after Telegram accepts a message but before sent_tweets is recorded.

notes.title: Dry-run default
notes.body: The dry-run command and run --dry-run both use a temporary SQLite copy by default. The dry-run command can opt into real state mutation with --write-state.

notes.title: Windows local proof limit
notes.body: PowerShell was not available on this Mac, and the GitHub credential lacks workflow scope, so Windows script execution is deferred to a real Windows host.

proof.title: Zero-account startup without secrets
proof.command: env -u X_BEARER_TOKEN -u TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN -u TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID .venv/bin/twitter-tg-notifs run --config examples/config.toml --state-db /tmp/twitter-tg-notifs-empty-final.sqlite3 --once
proof.result: checked_accounts=0 baselined=0 sent=0 would_send=0 skipped=0 errors=0

proof.title: No-impact dry-run smokes
proof.result: Both commands reported temporary state-copy usage and zero errors.

proof.title: Stale-reference grep
proof.command: rg for old project names, placeholders, stale web labels, unfinished-marker text, and old screenshot names
proof.result: Only the intentional README dry-run state sentence matched.

proof.title: Windows script proof limit
proof.command: PowerShell availability check and GitHub push attempt
proof.result: Local PowerShell was unavailable; GitHub rejected workflow-file updates because the OAuth credential lacks workflow scope.
